name: THSV StreamBridge - Scene Catalog
author: surakage
description: Reads available broadcast scenes for the authenticated StreamBridge setup wizard without changing the active scene.
safety: Read-only: uses OBS GetSceneList and WebSocket broadcast only; never changes the active scene. Streamlabs Desktop and Meld Studio use observed scene-change history because their Streamer.bot APIs do not expose full scene enumeration.
